items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we made a tape with Chic and we made one with Morgan.

ctx.x: Now my wife passed, she used to be a toddler player. But he gave up. Yeah.

Yeah. Well, interruptions and whatnot, but that's all right. You know, now what else can we talk about, see? All right. We, when we made the, you know, we made a tape with Chic and we made one with Morgan. We like to make them with all of them. You know, as many musicians as we can, just to get more ideas of your personality than, you know, than just people know you only as a piano player, or they know him as a trumpet player. But a lot of people don't know what you do when you're not playing music.
I wish I did before you played it.
